prompt:
Predict which option this user would choose. If no personal evidence is provided, judge what a typical user would prefer. Return {"probabilities": [one probability per option, in order, summing to 1], "rationale": "short reason"}.

Question: What experiment should the team run to determine whether negation-style annotations alone cause belief implantation, or whether stronger or different annotations can prevent it?", "options": ["Run a graded ladder of annotation strength, from brief prefixes to long explicit warnings and inline corrections, over many fabricated claims, with the full grid and every comparison fixed in advance.", "Test stronger annotations beyond simple prefix or suffix negations: repeated negations around every claim, explicit corrections stating the truth, and negations inside sentences."], "principles": [], "persona": "Evaluates model outputs through quick, holistic reading rather than systematic measurement.
